title: Install Futureverse in One Go
text: Start configuring Futureverse parallelize current computer: , takes minor tweak make existing lapply(), map(), foreach() code run parallel, e.g.
code: future::plan(future::multisession) ## future.apply: futurized version of base R apply library(future.apply) y <-        lapply(X, slow_fcn) y <- future_lapply(X, slow_fcn)  ## furrr: futurized version of purrr library(furrr) y <- X |>        map(slow_fcn) y <- X |> future_map(slow_fcn)  ## foreach: futurized version library(foreach) y <- foreach(x = X) %do%       slow_fcn(x) y <- foreach(x = X) %dofuture% slow_fcn(x)

title: Install Futureverse in One Go
text: Call: install: future - core Futureverse package future.apply - Futureverse variants base-R apply functions furrr - Futureverse variants purrr apply functions doFuture - Futureverse adaptors foreach package progressr - Near-live progress updates using Futureverse Call: install also additional parallel backends: future.mirai - modern alternative built-plan(multisession) future.callr - memory efficient alternative built-plan(multisession) future.batchtools - parallelize HPC job schedulers; Load Sharing Facility (LSF), OpenLava, TORQUE/PBS, Sun/Son /Oracle/Univa/Altair Grid Engine (SGE), Slurm
